title: Performance Whey Protein Blend (Chocolate)
body_html:
Maintaining muscle mass is important at every stage of life, whether you're an athlete, fitness enthusiast, busy professional, or simply looking to stay active and strong. Our Chocolate Whey Protein delivers 22 grams of protein per serving from a blend of whey protein isolate and whey protein concentrate to help support your daily protein intake. With a rich chocolate flavor and smooth texture, it's an easy addition to your wellness routine.

Protein plays a vital role in supporting muscle maintenance and normal recovery, especially when combined with regular physical activity and a balanced diet. This formula provides all essential amino acids naturally found in whey protein, making it a convenient option for post-workout nutrition or everyday protein support. Enjoy it after exercise, between meals, or whenever you need a protein boost.

We've also included resistant potato starch, a source of dietary fiber that complements this protein-forward formula. Naturally flavored and sweetened with stevia leaf extract, it contains no artificial sweeteners while delivering a satisfying chocolate taste. Simply mix with cold water, blend, or shake for a convenient and delicious protein shake anytime.


Ingredients: Whey Protein Blend (Whey Protein Isolate, Whey Protein Concentrate) (22g), Solnul® (Resistant Potato Starch), Natural Flavors, Pink Himalayan Crystal Salt, Guar Gum, Xanthan Gum, and Stevia Leaf Extract.
Manufacturer's country: USA
Product amount (oz/lbs/g): 18.55 oz / 1.16 lb / 525 g
Gross weight (oz/lbs/g): 22.22 oz / 1.39 lb / 630 g
Suggested use: Add one serving (2 scoops) to 8–12 oz (240–355 ml) of cold water and blend or shake thoroughly.
Warning: Do not exceed recommended dose. Consult a physician if pregnant, nursing, under 18, or have a medical condition.
KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN. DO NOT USE IF SAFETY SEAL IS DAMAGED OR MISSING. STORE IN A COOL, DRY PLACE.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
